name: 99216 · Spokane Vly, WA
findings: ZIP 99216 (Spokane Vly) has 50 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99216 (Spokane Vly) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
